ok so im filling out this online form for a teen savings account and it wants my age so i put 15 lol
but also real question, friday me and las 4 got boba and the receipt was $31. whats a normal share if its 4 people

Splitting $31 four ways comes to $7.75 each. Easy way to handle it: pick one person to request the money in a payment app, or just say "it's $7.75 each" in the chat so it's not awkward. If one person ordered something much pricier, you can split by what each person got, but for a casual group an even split is normal.

As for the form, it's fine to enter your real age. Teen accounts usually show the rates and options available to your age group after that, and some need a parent or guardian to co-sign, so check that part before you submit.

ya so i kinda just paid all of it so it wasnt weird 💀
it came out of the phone fund. how long until it comes back if i get like 130 every 2 weeks. i take orders at taqueria colima, my first check was about 130

Okay, so you covered the whole $31. If about $130 comes every two weeks, you earn roughly $65 a week, so $31 is about half a week of pay. If you save most of each check, you'd be back to where you were in about one pay period. Here's a quick way to see it:

- Check 1: $130, put in $31 back, and you're even
- Anything left over after that is new progress

If you want it to recover faster, you could set aside a fixed amount from each check first, then spend what's left. Want me to sketch a simple plan with a set amount per check?

maybe later. also bday stuff is coming up for brianna with las 4 so idk if ill be spending more lol
ok other thing. my cousin rafael picked me up friday after my shift and i wanna say thanks without it being cringe

Short and casual works best. A few options:

- Nice one: "Hey, thanks for picking me up after my shift Friday. It really helps, and I appreciate you."
- Real one: "thanks for the ride fr, you saved me from the bus lol"
- In between: "Thanks for always coming through with the rides. I owe you one, tell me what you want and I'll get it."

A specific detail, like the late pickup, makes it feel sincere instead of cringe. Want me to make one a bit shorter?

the in between one is good. ty bestie
anyway lol
Glad it helps! Send it whenever you're ready. If you want that savings plan or a way to handle the birthday spending, just ask. Good luck finishing the form!
